claims.quote: Mutations in PCDH19 gene, which encodes protocadherin-19 (PCDH19), cause Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy 9 (DEE9).
Heterogeneous loss of PCDH19 expression in neurons is considered a key determinant of the disorder;

claims.object_text: Pcdh19 mosaic mice (conditional knockout mouse model)
claims.quote: the hippocampus of Pcdh19 mosaic mice is characterized by structural and functional synaptic defects and by the presence of PCDH19-negative hyperexcitable neurons.
